description: First jaxFMM GPU campaign, FP32. Tier 1 (point): jaxFMM KIFMM p=4/6/8 point dipoles at the lattice sites; dip-fmm's point rows are taken from the FMM3D campaign tables, not re-measured. Tier 2 (finite, point targets): uniformly magnetised bodies, dip-fmm exact prism/tetrahedron sources versus jaxFMM constant-charge face triangles, both at the body centres with the self field included. Tier 3 (finite, averaged targets): dip-fmm prism-to-prism and tetra-to-tetra, reported on their own. Arms are paired by achieved accuracy in the analysis, never by nominal order.
kuhn_grids_note: Historical: this ladder kept root sides of the form 2^a 5^b because the aa9d75f solver lost 20-40 % of touching tetra->tetra fields on other sides. That was fixed in bc6adfa; any side is now within ~1e-8 (tests/test_normalisation.cpp).

article1_point_rows.description: dip-fmm point-to-point rows reused from the FMM3D campaign (Article1/results/processed): FP32 CudaFull spherical, lattice datasets, fastest feasible depth per size.
